overview: This Senate resolution supports designating April 20 through 24, 2026, as National Home Visiting Week. Home visiting programs send nurses, social workers or trained staff to families' homes to support parents during pregnancy and early childhood, promoting healthy development and reducing the risk of abuse and neglect. The findings cite the reach of the federal Maternal, Infant, and Early Childhood Home Visiting Program and similar services nationwide in 2024. The resolution supports the goals of the week. It is ceremonial and does not change any law or funding. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on April 28, 2026.
for: Supporters say home visiting helps parents give young children a strong start, and recognizing it highlights the work of home visitors and the families they serve.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
